hypotheses.claim: At Q=4096 dispersed, least-visited SparseLedger targeting has a meaningful FSCAUC advantage over equal-frequency uniform targeting without terminal HV harm.

success.condition: FSCAUC 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower >0.01, Holm q<0.05, and HV difference CI lower >=-0.005
success.claim_impact: Allow a bounded SparseLedger-targeting mechanism claim for high-Q dispersed synthetic landscapes.

failure.condition: FSCAUC CI upper <=0 or HV difference CI lower <-0.005
failure.claim_impact: Reject the claimed benefit or record a quality-failure boundary; no superiority wording.

inconclusive.condition: FSCAUC CI lower <=0.01 while CI upper >0, or Holm q>=0.05, with HV CI lower >=-0.005
inconclusive.claim_impact: Report insufficient evidence/precision; do not treat non-significance as equivalence.

hypotheses.claim: At Q=4096 dispersed, B5S has a meaningful FSCAUC advantage over B1 without terminal HV harm.

success.condition: FSCAUC 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower >0.01, Holm q<0.05, and HV difference CI lower >=-0.005
success.claim_impact: Allow a bounded total-injection-effect claim in the controlled benchmark family.

failure.condition: FSCAUC CI upper <=0 or HV difference CI lower <-0.005
failure.claim_impact: No total-injection advantage claim; record failure or quality tradeoff.

inconclusive.condition: FSCAUC CI lower <=0.01 while CI upper >0, or Holm q>=0.05, with HV CI lower >=-0.005
inconclusive.claim_impact: Report no conclusion and preserve B1 comparison as non-attributive.

hypotheses.claim: SparseLedger targeting benefit increases materially with discrete cardinality under dispersed feasible states.

primary_endpoint.metric: Q4096-minus-Q16 interaction in the B5S-minus-B5R landscape-level FSCAUC difference

success.condition: Interaction 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower >0.01 and Holm q<0.05
success.claim_impact: Allow a cardinality-dependent mechanism statement within the frozen generator.

failure.claim_impact: Reject the claimed high-Q amplification; investigate non-cardinality explanations only in a new plan.

inconclusive.condition: Interaction CI lower <=0.01 while CI upper >0 or Holm q>=0.05
inconclusive.claim_impact: No cardinality-amplification claim; report precision and observed estimates only.

hypotheses.claim: The Q=2 boundary is a harm-detection control only: SparseLedger targeting must not cause a terminal feasible-HV loss beyond the project guardrail, and this row cannot establish equivalence or a high-cardinality coverage mechanism.

primary_endpoint.metric: B5S-minus-B5R and B5S-minus-B1 landscape-level terminal normalized feasible-HV differences

success.condition: Both two-sided 95% landscape-bootstrap CI lower bounds are >=-0.005 and all truth/protocol guardrails pass
success.claim_impact: Report that no pre-specified harm boundary was detected in Q=2; do not claim equivalence, superiority or a SparseLedger targeting benefit.

failure.condition: Either two-sided 95% landscape-bootstrap CI upper bound is <-0.005
failure.claim_impact: Record a clear low-cardinality harm boundary and prohibit any unqualified benefit claim.

inconclusive.condition: At least one HV CI spans -0.005, while no protocol guardrail invalidates the batch
inconclusive.claim_impact: Precision is insufficient to classify the Q=2 harm boundary; report estimates and intervals only.

guardrails.monitored_during: H1 and H2 formal contrasts after the fixed 10000-NFE endpoint
guardrails.kill_action: Downgrade the corresponding coverage benefit to a quality-tradeoff/failure result and prohibit superiority language.
guardrails.claim_impact: A method cannot be called beneficial if coverage gain breaches the terminal-HV noninferiority guardrail.

guardrails.monitored_during: every preflight, smoke and formal run
guardrails.kill_action: Invalidate and stop the affected batch before analysis.
guardrails.claim_impact: Any oracle leakage voids all algorithm-performance and mechanism claims from the affected batch.

stopping.rule: fixed matrix with no significance-driven early stopping
stopping.limit: 6720 formal runs, each exactly 10000 NFE; current authorization limit is 0 formal performance runs
stopping.action_on_exhaustion: Report incomplete/inconclusive; request a new authorization rather than changing NFE, seeds or exclusions.
